sources.snippet: This is the high-performance quantization and serving release of DavidAU's flagship Qwen3.8-27B Cold Fusion checkpoint, packaged and optimized by Solstice-AI. Featuring a historic 735 ARC-C and 882 ARC-E, this model delivers an unprecedented 9-for-9 clean sweep over Claude Opus 4.6 Max across the official Claude Code benchmark harness.
